zh.title: 北卡州救護員駕eVTOL赴911呼叫較救護車早20分鐘抵達
zh.summary: Hyde County EMS使用Pivotal BlackFly執行兩次緊急醫療出動；救護員Reece提前到場提供高級生命支援。
body: 美國北卡羅來納州鄉村地區的Hyde County Emergency Medical Services表示，受過飛行訓練的救護員Quinn Reece駕駛Pivotal BlackFly電動垂直起降航空器，執行了兩次緊急出動任務，攜帶醫療裝備並在病患附近降落。
在其中一次呼叫中，Reece較地面救護車提早約20分鐘抵達，並在其他救援人員仍在途中時開始提供高級生命支援。Hyde County及其計畫合作夥伴將這些任務描述為美國首次將eVTOL航空器用於例行緊急醫療出動。
該航空器的用途並非取代救護車或運送病患，而是讓救護員與關鍵醫療裝置更快抵達現場，尤其在長距離會拖慢傳統緊急應變的地區。Hyde County涵蓋北卡羅來納州東部近1,500平方英里的陸地與水域。
Reece直接飛往緊急現場附近的GPS座標，機上攜帶的裝置包括心臟監視器、呼吸道器材及主要應變袋。Hyde County EMS局長Brook Cox表示：「我們所做的每個決策都是為了更快將高級照護帶給我們的居民。」
Hyde County EMS、Pivotal與緊急服務公司Code Blue Resources歷經數月研擬以航空器執行緊急呼叫的程序，在展開營運飛行前完成超過300次訓練演練。Akute Networks亦以航空計畫管理人身分參與。
BlackFly與Joby Aviation、Archer Aviation等公司開發中較大型eVTOL空中計程車不同，屬輕量單座電動航空器，可垂直起降，使救護員能在傳統飛機甚至直升機不適用的地點操作。Pivotal將BlackFly及較新的Helix定位為個人電動航空器而非商用空中計程車。

en.title: North Carolina paramedic flies eVTOL to 911 call, beats ambulance by 20 minutes
en.summary: Hyde County EMS used a Pivotal BlackFly on two emergency calls; paramedic Reece arrived early and began advanced life support.
body: Hyde County Emergency Medical Services in rural North Carolina said flight-trained paramedic Quinn Reece used a Pivotal BlackFly electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft on two emergency response calls, carrying medical equipment and landing near the patients.

On one of the calls, Reece arrived about 20 minutes ahead of a ground ambulance and began providing advanced life support while other responders were still en route. Hyde County and its program partners describe the missions as the first use of an eVTOL aircraft for routine emergency medical response in the US.

The aircraft is not intended to replace ambulances or transport patients by air. Instead, it is used to get a paramedic and critical medical equipment to the scene faster, particularly in places where long distances can slow conventional emergency response. Hyde County covers nearly 1,500 square miles of land and water in eastern North Carolina.

Reece flew directly to GPS coordinates near the emergency scenes. Equipment carried aboard included a cardiac monitor, airway supplies and a primary response bag. Hyde County EMS Chief Brook Cox said the missions proved that distance can be overcome to reach patients sooner.

Hyde County EMS, Pivotal and emergency-services company Code Blue Resources developed procedures for using the aircraft on emergency calls over a number of months and completed more than 300 training exercises before beginning operational flights. Akute Networks also worked on the program as aviation program manager.

The BlackFly is a lightweight, single-seat electric aircraft that can take off and land vertically, allowing the paramedic to operate from locations where a conventional airplane or even a helicopter would not be practical. Pivotal has positioned the BlackFly and its newer Helix aircraft as personal electric aircraft rather than commercial air taxis.
